clips.title: The story
paras: Wounded Ancients is an Alliance task given by Kaela Shadowspear in the Stonetalon Mountains. Suspecting that goblin munitions drove the local forest guardians mad, Kaela sends adventurers to recover shrapnel lodged in the corrupted treants so the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle can analyze the taint.

The forested groves of Stonetalon were long watched over by towering treants, gentle yet ferocious guardians bound to the health of the land. When the Venture Company moved in with buzzsaws, explosives, and strip-mining operations, nature fought back. The treants successfully repelled the invaders from parts of the vale, but victory came at an insidious cost. The defenders did not return to peaceful guardianship; instead, they devolved into hostile, maddened husks.

Kaela Shadowspear, an Alliance scout stationed in the mountains, believes the treants' decline is no natural sickness. The gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle suspects the culprit lies in the chemical and mechanical arsenal used by the goblins during their chaotic retreat. By prying corroded shrapnel from the wounded wood-beasts, Gaxim hopes to determine whether Venture Company ordnance is actively poisoning Stonetalon's ancient protectors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems obvious to me that the protectors of the Vale—the treants—had something to do with the Venture Co. Being driven back. Unfortunately, even those once great guardians have now become corrupt.
Gaxim thinks their corruption is somehow linked to the weapons the goblins used during their retreat.
I told him I'd collect a sample from a wounded treant and allow him to study it in order to figure out if that's true.
Bring me some of the shrapnel so the gnome can tell me more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have a feeling Gaxim will find a use for the shrapnel regardless of how the Venture Co. Has used it in the past.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This should be more than sufficient for Gaxim to figure out how the treants were corrupted. I shall give this to him right away.
